question: Who approves restored dataset/model/connector integrity, resumed machine access and reuse of backup data for AI, and which practice operates each control?
evidence_requested: Joint recovery-to-AI-restart checklist; dataset/model/version dependencies; supported AI objects and APIs; data-use rights; lifecycle/security/recovery responsibility matrix.
decision_needed: Approve only the new operational interface and evidence handoff. AIG governance and all closed AIG definition decisions remain intact.

issue: The source can imply fixed coverage, same staff, automatic containment or guaranteed recovery despite different customer, OEM and specialist responsibilities.
handling: Use coherent governed handoff, scoped managed delivery, customer approvals and incident decision rights. No fixed support hours, response SLA or staff-continuity promise is introduced.
question: Who is incident lead, who declares containment, who authorises restoration, and which party provides each support window and response commitment?
evidence_requested: Service catalogue/SOW, OEM support terms, incident RACI, escalation/approval runbooks, staffing and on-call evidence for any future time-bound claims.
decision_needed: Approve hours, entitlements, exclusions and authorised actions per engagement; distinguish Quadra managed delivery from OEM SaaS operations and separate incident-response retainers.

issue: Framework counts, automatic compliance, tamper-proof evidence and forensically sound collection claims exceed what a platform feature alone establishes.
handling: Present control mapping, automated-check/report candidates, preservation, chain-of-custody and legal review as requirements and evidence inputs. No blanket compliance or evidentiary-admissibility promise.

decision_needed: Approve a scoped control/evidence mapping and legal owner; do not promise all regulations are met or reuse unsupported 100+ framework counts.

issue: Source absolutes and numeric promotions include whatever happens, clean recovery every time, instantly, zero impact, continuous uptime, any device/network, 3x TCO, 40% savings, 26 regions and a $10M guarantee.
handling: Replace with design objectives, supported-platform checks, representative tests, explicit dependencies and customer-specific economics. Remove percentage/multiple/guarantee/region-count claims from page copy.

evidence_requested: Current vendor legal terms and eligibility; independent cost assumptions and customer baseline; recovery/performance test records; current region matrix.
